summary: Iterasi 289 — verified 'Tugas Sopir Hari Ini' increment end-to-end. Backend: 15 new pytest cases (GET /api/logistics/drivers RBAC, GET /deliveries?mine=true ownership+sorting, POST /my-route reorder/persist/foreign-id/400/422/403, PATCH driver_user_id assign+unassign+delivered-lock) — all passed (1 skipped: no unassigned Surat Jalan in ent_ksc so the POST-create-with-driver_user_id path could only be covered via PATCH + code review). Regression suites test_fb02_logistics.py and test_iter288_logistics_gps.py still green (40 passed / 15 skipped, skips are pre-existing data-dependent guards). Frontend: driver@ lands on Logistik with driver-today-panel ('2 tujuan aktif · 1 terkirim hari ini'), 2 active tasks numbered 1..2 (delivered LG-00002 correctly excluded), driver-task-late-* shown on LG-00005 (eta 2026-09-01), down-arrow swap works and PERSISTS after reload, up/down disabled at list edges, task body opens logistics-detail-modal. Admin: no driver panel, Buat Pengiriman → Armada sendiri → logistics-driver-select renders 'Joko Susilo' and selecting it fills logistics-driver with 'Joko Susilo'. Sales: read-only banner, no driver panel, no create button. Route order restored to 1/2 (LG-00005, LG-00007); no deliveries created or deleted; LG-00007 left in in_transit.

minor.issue: Driver role bootstrap fires these two calls on login and gets 403 (4 console errors per page load). No functional impact (panel renders fine) but noisy — gate these fetches by permission for role `driver`.

issues: ETA field uses the native browser date input (logistics-eta, mm/dd/yyyy US format) instead of the app's KN/shadcn calendar — inconsistent with the Indonesian locale used elsewhere. Pre-existing, low priority.

action_items: Optional: suppress the driver-role 403s on /api/uoms and /api/document-templates during app bootstrap.
Optional: swap logistics-eta native date input for the app calendar component.
critical_code_review_comments: logistics_service.list_deliveries sorts in Python after a Mongo sort (route_order nulls→9999) — correct for the current small driver dataset but note the 1000-doc to_list cap will truncate before sorting if a driver ever exceeds it.
set_my_route uses matched_count so foreign ids are silently ignored and all-foreign yields 400 — matches spec; no permission leak found (driver can only touch rows where driver_user_id == own id).
seed_data_creation: None — no deliveries created; only route_order toggled and restored (LG-00005=1, LG-00007=2); PATCH driver_user_id on LG-00005 unassigned then re-assigned to user_driver_01.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ent_ksc has NO unassigned Surat Jalan (both remaining unassigned SJ belong to ent_kanda), so the POST /api/logistics/deliveries create path (incl. driver_user_id on create) cannot be exercised from KSC without seeding — use /app/backend/tests/fb02_seed_shipments.py if needed. Driver Joko (user_driver_01) has active LG-00005 (prepared, late ETA) and LG-00007 (in_transit), plus delivered LG-00002 (delivered today → summary shows '1 terkirim hari ini'). Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter289_driver_today.py (self-restoring route order).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found in the increment.
